title: Caffè Latte
detail: Rich, full-bodied espresso in steamed milk, lightly topped with foam. A caffè latte is simply a shot or two of bold, tasty espresso with fresh, sweet steamed milk over it.

title: Cappuccino
detail: Espresso with steamed milk, topped with a deep layer of foam.

title: Caffè Mocha
detail: Espresso with bittersweet mocha sauce and steamed milk, topped with sweetened whipped cream. Delightful.

title: Caramel Macchiato
detail: Espresso combined with vanilla-flavoured syrup, milk and caramel sauce over ice. A Starbucks classic, chilled for a classic summer’s day. To our signature espresso we add a creamy mix of vanilla syrup and cold milk poured over ice; it’s then topped with our proprietary buttery caramel sauce. Sweet!

title: Vanilla Sweet Cream Cold Brew
detail: Just before serving, our slow-steeped Cold Brew is topped with a delicate float of house-made vanilla sweet cream that cascades throughout the cup.

title: Cold Brew
detail: Slow-steeped, small-batch and super smooth. To create our signature recipe, our team spent months experimenting with different brew times and coffee varietals. We specifically developed the Starbucks® Cold Brew Blend to heighten the rich, naturally sweet flavor created during the cold brewing process.

title: Mango Passion Frappuccino
detail: A tropical mango and passionfruit infusion, perfectly blended with a fruity hibiscus tea and ice.

title: Raspberry Currant Frappuccino
detail: Made with freshly brewed Teavana® tea, blended juice and ice.

title: Coffee Frappuccino
detail: Starbucks® coffee is blended with nonfat milk and ice for a sip on the light side.

title: Mocha Frappuccino
detail: Mocha sauce, Frappuccino® roast coffee, milk and ice all come together for a mocha flavor that'll leave you wanting more.
